method.hpsa_filter: Ohio rows with HPSA Status != Withdrawn and nonmissing Latitude/Longitude
method.site_filter: Ohio Health Center Service Delivery and Look-Alike Sites rows with nonmissing geocoding X/Y
method.matching: nearest site coordinate to each HPSA coordinate using haversine distance
method.purpose: crosswalk probe only; no entity identity was asserted from proximity

interpretation: The coordinate crosswalk is strongest for FQHC and look-alike HPSA rows and weaker for correctional and rural-health rows. Proximity does not prove that the nearest site is the designated HPSA entity, offers primary care to the designated population, accepts a patient's insurance, has open appointments, or was used.
next_test: Validate organization/site identifiers and service type, then add hours, patient/insurance acceptance, appointment wait, and a defined travel-time method. Keep the crosswalk as a candidate-link screen rather than promoting it to provider capacity or resident access.
storage_boundary: Only compact aggregate counts and distance summaries are retained; the 14 MB temporary source CSV is not added to the repository.
